parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of wood, forming the front opening panel of the storage cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space by opening and closing.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Glass
parts.Basic_description: This is a transparent glass panel fitted into the cabinet door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides visibility into the cabinet while protecting the contents from dust.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed within the door frame and does not move independently.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts and provides the overall shape and stability of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structure and does not move.

parts.name: Mesh (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is a diagonal mesh support bar made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It reinforces the door structure and prevents deformation.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Mesh (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is another steel mesh bar forming part of the cross-bracing on the door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional structural support and rigidity to the door.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Connector (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is a small metal connector or handle located at the bottom of the door.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a handle or hinge connector to facilitate door operation.
parts.Movement_description: It may rotate or act as a pivot point depending on its function.
